title: Bottom-adjacent spatial refinement and Richards reference-grid audit
scientific_question: Is the small CURRENT_LAYER_FACE residual localized by C5B caused by the 10-cm bottom-adjacent LARE layer, or does it persist after boundary-cell refinement once the Richards reference grid is independently refined?

frozen_workload.forcing: exact C5A gravity-consistent top qeq and 0.875/1.125 prescribed-head factors

existing_anchor.source: exact C5A artifact; do not regenerate for authority

reference_grid_audit.numerical_policy: exact C5A/C4Z pre-existing D13 integrated-water-depth retry policy
reference_grid_audit.purpose: Measure Reference spatial-grid shift before attributing the C5A/C5B residual solely to LARE.

lare_bottom_refinement.invariant: 0-150 cm remains the C5B 10-cm uniform grid. Only the bottom 150-160 cm interval is split.
lare_bottom_refinement.baseline_identity: B10 against exact C5A R16 Reference must reproduce C5B R16 CURRENT_LAYER_FACE dt=2.5e-5 signed-flux diagnostics.

reference_refinement: R16 and R32 signed/phase errors relative to R64
lare_refinement: B10, B5 and B2P5 pooled signed mean and bottom-flux RMSE relative to R64
history- and phase-specific signed error relative to R64
B10-to-B5 and B5-to-B2P5 bottom-flux timeseries shifts
three-level bottom-cell-thickness signed-bias convergence order and h->0 extrapolation when defined

diagnostic_adjudication.BOTTOM_CELL_SPATIAL_CONVERGENCE_PRESENT: Absolute pooled signed bias and pooled flux RMSE both decrease strictly B10 -> B5 -> B2P5 against R64.
diagnostic_adjudication.BOTTOM_CELL_SPATIAL_PLATEAU: The nested B10 -> B5 -> B2P5 sequence does not reduce both diagnostics monotonically.
diagnostic_adjudication.REFERENCE_REFINEMENT_PROGRESSING: R32-to-R64 bottom-flux RMSE is smaller than R16-to-R32 RMSE.
diagnostic_adjudication.REFERENCE_REFINEMENT_NOT_PROGRESSING: R32-to-R64 bottom-flux RMSE is not smaller than R16-to-R32 RMSE.
diagnostic_adjudication.interpretation: These labels diagnose mechanism only. They do not alter C5A acceptance or authorize a new closure.

next_logic.if_bottom_cell_converges_and_reference_p: Quantify whether h->0 extrapolation removes the prescribed-head residual before considering a new closure.
next_logic.if_bottom_cell_plateaus_and_reference_pr: Closure-algebra investigation may be opened prospectively; no fitted closure is yet authorized.
next_logic.if_reference_not_progressing: Do not attribute residual to LARE closure; Reference spatial authority must be extended first.
next_logic.if_R32_or_R64_blocked: Close C5C as Reference-grid blocker without retuning numerical policy.

pre_execution_implementation_binding.reason: C5C is motivated by C5B localization, but the nested grids and diagnostics are frozen before generating any R32/R64 Reference response.
pre_execution_implementation_binding.allowed_new_code: Reference geometry materialization and diagnostic bottom-cell partition refinement only
pre_execution_implementation_binding.prohibited_new_code: new closure law, fitted conductivity law, acceptance threshold changes, production implementation
